working_definition: T5b is one of the four directional subtypes (a-d) of T5, the OFF-motion direction-selective columnar neurons of the Drosophila optic lobe. It is defined by its axon terminal targeting lobula plate layer 2 (layer b), and its dendrites arborise in lobula layer Lo1. T5b encodes back-to-front diagonal motion and is a first-order OFF-pathway direction-selective neuron.

best_match.fbbt_definition: T5 neuron with its lobula plate arbor in layer 2 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). It responds to motion in a diagonal back-to-front direction (Henning et al., 2022).

justification: FBbt:00003738 'T5b neuron' is defined as the T5 subtype with its lobula plate arbor in layer 2 — precisely the anatomical identity described for this cluster (OFF-motion columnar neuron, dendrites in lobula Lo1, axon terminals in lobula plate layer 2, back-to-front diagonal direction tuning). The FBbt label is identical to the cluster label (T5b). The FBbt term is not obsolete. The parent term FBbt:00003736 'T5 neuron' is more general and rejected as the cluster has the layer-specific subtype identity that FBbt:00003738 captures exactly.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Pre- versus postsynaptic innervation judged by scoring of terminal morphology from figures in Fischbach and Dittrich (1989) as assessed by FlyBrain Neuron DB. The neurotransmitter was assessed with a split-GAL4 strategy using a Chat-DBD allele (FBal0198074) (Mauss et al., 2014) and single-cell transcript profiling (Shinomiya et al., 2014). Connectivity in the lobula was assessed by serial section electron microscopy of a single column (Shinomiya et al., 2014).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Parent class of T5b; too broad — does not capture the layer 2 / lobula plate specificity or directional identity of T5b. FBbt:00003738 is the appropriate exact-match subtype.

recommendation: Accept FBbt:00003738 'T5b neuron' as an exact match. The FBbt term was found by direct label search, is non-obsolete, and its definition fully aligns with the cluster's anatomical identity (T5 subtype, lobula plate layer 2 arbor, OFF-motion, back-to-front direction tuning).
